How this collection was prepared

Supplied exam notes and presentation transcripts were consolidated into original family guides. Claims were checked against the linked public guidance on 26 October 2026. Hypotheses, testimonials and dosing tables were not adopted as treatment recommendations.

No named clinician review has been recorded for this collection. The doctors named in the original notes are not credited as authors or endorsers. These pages provide general education, not an individual assessment or prescription.

International guidance is labelled by source; it does not establish Indian regulatory approval, local prevalence or entitlement to services. We avoid promises of cures and focus on comfort, communication and participation.
